metadata.title: The Voice of The Army
metadata.creator: WA4CZD
metadata.description:
The Voice of the Army was produced by the U.S. Army Recruiting Publicity Bureau. Dates are approximate.

"Names on the List" was written by Cpl. Jacques Finke and Cpl. Donald Agger, and won an Ohio State Citation in 1945.

Good sound, good program, five stars
